subfamily: suffering bastard (ginger long drink, split base)
_status: v1 (Tomas, round 3). Scialom's Suffering Bastard (Proper p. 264) riffed: fresh lime for the lime cordial (the classic went OUT on sugar, 9.86 vs 7.0, and the cordial is Not Only the Way's), ginger beer rebuilt as a cooked ginger syrup + soda (Codex p. 48: bartenders use ginger syrup with soda for ginger beer) with toasted cumin, the Flavor Matrix's surprising pairing for ginger (pdf 132). Syrup sweep 30-40 ml all in range.
